flyer.justification: The draft captures the core theme of the talk accurately, but the main title slightly exceeds the 6-word limit requirement.

instagram.justification: Adheres perfectly to all Instagram requirements including carousel cues, CTA, and exactly 10 targeted hashtags.

summary.justification: An excellent briefing that captures specific numerical evidence from the talk while staying well under the 400-word limit.

linkedin.justification: Follows all LinkedIn content guidelines strictly, avoiding buzzwords/cliches and incorporating 5 targeted hashtags.

newsletter.justification: Includes a concise subject line under 50 characters, three well-structured sections with bold subheadings, and a conversational editorial tone.

blog.justification: Comprehensive long-form Markdown post featuring numbered sections, a comparison table, author profile section, and deep coverage of all key points.
